MERIDIAN WORN GARAGE DETAILS — ORIGINAL ASSETS, LAST VEHICLE 1.13

These twelve models, palette definitions, authoring scripts and original
inspection renders were created for Last Vehicle / A GingrSnaps Project
from numerical geometry. They contain no downloaded models, photographs,
texture art, music, logos or third-party character designs.

The original asset contribution is dedicated under CC0 1.0 Universal:
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode

To the extent copyright and related rights exist in this contribution, they
are waived under that dedication. These assets may be edited, redistributed
and used commercially. No attribution is required. Retaining this provenance
notice is appreciated.

The generator's mesh construction helpers and palette are adapted from the
project's original CC0 Meridian Industrial Detail Pack. Blender and Babylon.js
remain separate software under their own licenses. Inspection labels do not
embed font data in the game models. No program is relicensed by this notice.
